# HTML Color Codes

> > A comprehensive resource for color selection, conversion, and reference with interactive tools for web design, game development, and color theory.

HTML Color Codes provides interactive color pickers, wheels, and conversion tools alongside extensive reference libraries for HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Material Design, and gaming platforms. The site supports multiple color formats including Hex, RGB, HSL, HSV, OKLCH, and CMYK for seamless color workflow integration.

## Key Topics

- Hex Color Codes
- RGB Values
- HSL/HSV Color Models
- Color Picker Tools
- Color Wheel & Harmonies
- Tailwind CSS Colors
- Material Design Palette
- Web Safe Colors
- Color Conversion
- HTML Color Names
- Color Charts & References
- Minecraft Color Codes
- OKLCH Color Format
- CMYK Conversion
- Flat Design Colors

## Core Tools

- [Color Picker](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-picker): Interactive hex color picker with RGB, HSL, HSV, OKLCH export options
- [Color Wheel](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-wheel): Color wheel tool for generating complementary, analogous, triadic schemes
- [Homepage](https://htmlcolorcodes.com): Homepage with color pickers, wheels, charts and HTML/CSS color code tools

## Color Charts & Palettes

- [Color Chart](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-chart): Color charts for Tailwind CSS, Material Design, flat design, web safe
- [Tailwind Color Chart](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-chart/tailwind-color-chart): Tailwind CSS color palette reference with export and download options
- [Material Design Color Chart](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-chart/material-design-color-chart): Google Material Design color system with flat style vibrant schemes
- [Flat Design Color Chart](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-chart/flat-design-color-chart): Flat design color palette with bold, bright colors for clean interfaces
- [Web Safe Color Chart](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-chart/web-safe-color-chart): Web safe color palette of 216 standardized colors from early internet era

## Color References & Libraries

- [Color Names](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-names): Reference of 140 named HTML colors with Hex, RGB, HSL values
- [Color Library](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/colors): Comprehensive color library with 100+ shades and Hex, RGB, HSL codes
- [Shades of Red](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/colors/shades-of-red): Red color shades with names like crimson, cardinal, vermilion with codes

## Color Conversion Tools

- [RGB to Hex](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/rgb-to-hex): Tool to convert RGB values to Hex with HSL, HSV, CMYK equivalents
- [Hex to RGB](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/hex-to-rgb): Tool to convert Hex color codes to RGB with HSL, HSV, CMYK values

## Gaming Color Codes

- [Minecraft Color Codes](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/minecraft-color-codes): Minecraft chat and format codes for styling in-game text and commands
- [Bukkit Color Codes](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/bukkit-color-codes): Bukkit color and format codes for Minecraft server chat and MOTD
- [Roblox Color Codes](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/roblox-color-codes): Roblox BrickColor codes for game development on the platform

## Optional

- [Blog](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/blog): Blog featuring color tools, palette generators, typography, web resources
